We have identified a functional disruption impacting New Concur Travel hotel searches via the Amadeus Global Distribution Systems (GDS) in the US2 Data Center.
When users enter their hotel search criteria and select Search, the error message “Invalid search response from supplier.” is displayed. 
Unfortunately, there is no workaround for the issue at this time.

The Incident Response Team (IRT) is currently investigating the issue.
Our next scheduled update will be in one hour.

We identified a functional disruption impacting New Concur Travel hotel searches via the Amadeus Global Distribution Systems (GDS) in the US2 Data Center.
When users enter their hotel search criteria and select Search, the error message “Invalid search response from supplier.” was displayed.
Unfortunately, there was no workaround for the issue during service impact.
 
Services have returned to normal operating levels. We will continue monitoring performance for the next 15-30 minutes to verify stability. Once verified as stable the incident will be resolved.

We identified a functional disruption impacting New Concur Travel hotel searches via the Amadeus Global Distribution Systems (GDS) in the US2 Data Center.
When users entered their hotel search criteria and select Search, the error message “Invalid search response from supplier.” was displayed.
Unfortunately, there was no workaround for the issue during service impact.
 
The Incident Response Team (IRT) made a configuration change by changing the domain-fronting profile action from block to monitor restored service.
 
We have verified that service performance is stable and will now resolve this incident.
An investigation into the root cause of this incident will now be conducted, and a root cause analysis report provided when that investigation is complete.
